name: job_wait
description: Wait for a background job to settle, up to `timeout_ms` (max 30000). Returns the job's result and recent output when it finishes, or a still-running status with the output tail when the timeout expires. Use it after starting a background workflow or job when you need the result in this turn; otherwise the completion notice will arrive by itself.

timeout_ms.description: Maximum wait in milliseconds, capped at 30000. Defaults to 10000.

prompt: job_wait: wait up to timeout_ms for a background job to settle and return its result; on timeout, report that it is still running with its output tail.
